tasks.description: Calculate the distance between the westernmost and easternmost cities.

result.python_code:
# Define the longitudes of the cities mentioned
cities_longitudes = {
    'New York City': -74.006,
    'Cincinnati': -84.512,
    'Staunton': -79.071,
    'Yorba Linda': -117.678,
    'Omaha': -95.998,
    'Plains': -84.368
}

# Find the westernmost and easternmost cities
westernmost_city = min(cities_longitudes, key=cities_longitudes.get)
 easternmost_city = max(cities_longitudes, key=cities_longitudes.get)

# Calculate the distance between the westernmost and easternmost cities
# Using the longitudes to calculate the distance in degrees
westernmost_longitude = cities_longitudes[westernmost_city]
 easternmost_longitude = cities_longitudes[easternmost_city]

# Distance in degrees
distance_degrees = easternmost_longitude - westernmost_longitude

# Print the results clearly
print(f'Westernmost City: {westernmost_city}')
print(f'Easternmost City: {easternmost_city}')
print(f'Distance between the westernmost and easternmost cities (in degrees): {distance_degrees}')
